title: An actor assertion lives at most two minutes; the agent cannot make a symbolic link that leaves the site; an assistant answer keeps the token counts the provider reported, and unknown stays unknown
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd` with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a scratch Postgres.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.
fence: verifyActor bounds the expiry at 120 s; commandApprovalReason refuses ln -s to an absolute, home or .. target; saveTurn keeps provider usage and NULL when absent. Throwaway Postgres and local doubles, no network.

tests: dsh prompter assertion verifies only with the actor key and a bounded expiry
a symbolic link that leaves the site folder is refused
the provider’s token counts reach the answer’s row
the stream request asks for usage
